findings.claim: The question spans a transition from scattered residue, through reactivation and measured ordering, to creative formation as something new.
findings.mechanism: Rufatan supplies dispersed material; mabuthuna supplies motion out of inertness; khalqan carries attributed measure and bringing-forth branches; jadidan marks a renewed endpoint.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the objection encompass the passage from broken remains to a newly formed state.
findings.containment: The transition is retained as an attributed HFT reading alongside ordinary resurrection wording; measure-before-formation is not asserted as an unmarked dictionary gloss.

epistemic.reason: The HFT interpretation is legacy_unbound; its word and root coordinates match supplied QAC occurrences, so it is retained as attributed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Henüz üzerinden günler geçmemiş, yeni yapılmış veya yeniden yeni olmuş bulunma ana anlamdır.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The imagined result is a renewed configuration after fragmentation.

findings.title: The spoken counter-model
findings.claim: The quoted speech presents a position in which fragmentation is treated as excluding creative renewal, turning the question into a public counter-model.
findings.mechanism: Qalu carries an attributed adoption-of-view branch; rufatan supplies the premise and khalqan the creative possibility the speakers' words reject.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears a stated position about what fragments permit, not only private uncertainty.
findings.containment: This is an attributed reading of the speakers' argument; it does not establish that fragmentation rules out creation or replace the ordinary question.

epistemic.reason: The HFT interpretation is legacy_unbound; its word and root coordinates match supplied QAC occurrences, so it is retained as attributed.
